skills.name: merrin-poly-canonical
skills.scope: Merge rational coefficients at equal power triples and sort lexicographically by field, velocity, acceleration powers.
skills.boundary: Input order has no mathematical role, but every surviving exponent tuple must retain its coefficient. Empty terms means the zero polynomial, whose degree remains undefined.

skills.name: merrin-poly-add
skills.scope: Add two finite formal polynomials over rational coefficients.
skills.boundary: Cancellation must remove a term exactly. A missing empirical measurement is never encoded as a zero polynomial by this operation.

skills.name: merrin-poly-multiply
skills.scope: Distribute every pair of terms and combine equal exponent triples.
skills.boundary: The cross term is essential for binomial products. Enforce input and expansion budgets before allowing an unbounded product.

skills.name: merrin-d-phi
skills.scope: Differentiate formally with respect to the field coordinate q.
skills.boundary: Velocity and acceleration are independent jet coordinates during this partial derivative. A zero result is a formal statement about the declared expression.

skills.name: merrin-d-velocity
skills.scope: Differentiate formally with respect to the velocity coordinate v.
skills.boundary: A velocity-linear term has a nonzero first derivative and zero Hessian; these observations serve different purposes.

skills.name: merrin-jet-degree
skills.scope: Report total degree and each coordinate degree after exact cancellation.
skills.boundary: Component maxima may arise in different monomials and must not be summed to obtain total degree. Zero has null degrees.

skills.name: merrin-field-parity
skills.scope: Classify simultaneous sign reversal of q, v and a by total exponent parity.
skills.boundary: This is a declared algebraic symmetry check. It does not establish a symmetry of an unspecified physical action or its boundary conditions.

skills.name: merrin-coordinate-scale
skills.scope: Substitute independent rational coordinate scales without changing exponent labels.
skills.boundary: Zero scales are permitted as substitutions here; unlike affine pullback they are not claimed to be invertible coordinate transformations.

skills.name: merrin-jet-value
skills.scope: Evaluate a finite polynomial at a complete rational triple q, v, a.
skills.boundary: Values are exact evaluations at declared synthetic points. They carry no sensor, calibration, data collection or trajectory provenance.

skills.name: merrin-coefficient-at
skills.scope: Read the coefficient at a specific nonnegative exponent triple after normalization.
skills.boundary: An absent formal monomial has coefficient zero under this closed polynomial contract. This does not make an absent scientific dataset a measured zero.
